title: Orgrimmar (faction)
wikitext:
{{Stub}} {{Infobox faction |affiliation=[[Horde]] | name = Orgrimmar | image = Orgrimmar.jpg | faction=Horde | base = Northern [[Durotar]] {{co|46|12|Durotar}} | leader = [[Thrall|Warchief Thrall]] |government=Tribal chiefdom | rewards = {{MountIcon|Wolf|Small}} [[Wolf]] mounts (rare and epic) }} '''Orgrimmar''' is the faction of the [[Orc]] capital city [[Orgrimmar]] located on the northern edge of the region of [[Durotar]]. The city is a fortified complex guarded by stout walls, massive gates and tall towers. The mountainous ranges of northern Durotar form a natural barrier to the rear of the fortress, and parts of the complex are carved into the mountain itself. == Reputation == [[Rashona Straglash]] has the Orgrimmar repeatable cloth quests used by non-orcish Horde players to obtain the right to ride [[Wolf#Wolves_as_Mounts]] at Exalted.

Surrounding zones [[Durotar]] and [[The Barrens]] have the most quests for gaining reputation with Orgrimmar. == Rewards== Orcs can ride [[Wolf]] Mounts {{MountIcon|Wolf|Small}} by default, with a normal mount at level 20. Epic wolf mounts can be taught to ride at level 40.

Other Horde races who are {{rep|exalted}} with Orgrimmar can also learn to ride wolf mounts. [[Category:Horde factions]]
